races.paceDynamic: Bamako Beach and Absoluteassignment are the only confirmed front runners in this 13-runner field, creating a relatively modest early pace. With most of the field preferring hold-up tactics, the early leaders should get an uncontested lead through reasonable fractions. This sets up a tactical race where the pace will likely quicken from the 3f pole as the large contingent of hold-up horses make their moves. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leaders without being too far back, as they can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop when multiple hold-up horses converge late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Bamako Beach or Absoluteassignment get uncontested fractions and kick clear turning for home
scenarios.body: With so many hold-up horses leaving it late, the early pace-setters could steal vital lengths before the cavalry charge arrives. This scenario particularly suits Bamako Beach who showed promise when second at 7f on soft ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If The Publican's Son or Starred can settle prominently behind the leaders without using up energy
scenarios.body: The highest-rated horses can position themselves perfectly to strike when the pace quickens, avoiding the traffic problems that will hit the deep closers. Their class advantage becomes decisive in a sustained drive from the 2f pole.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and multiple hold-up horses get clear runs simultaneously
scenarios.body: The front runners fade badly and several hold-up horses find racing room to mount serious challenges in the final furlong. This requires perfect timing and luck in running for the closers to be effective.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver
scenarios.trigger: If Glasarmi shows significant improvement from his break or Shaws Bay builds on his promising debut fourth
scenarios.body: An unexposed runner capitalizes on a strong pace scenario to register a breakthrough victory. The combination of class and freshness proves decisive against more exposed rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Loch Gamhna will lead from the gates with no serious pace pressure in this field, setting a comfortable tempo through the early furlongs. Kalir and Casamorati may track in second and third but both lack the natural pace to challenge the leader early. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses like Satoyama, Hippology, Captain Con and Stellar View, this creates a pedestrian gallop that builds gradually. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace without pressure, as the large field of hold-up horses will create traffic problems in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Loch Gamhna gets an easy lead and maintains it through halfway
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate terms and kick clear when the field comes under pressure. His prominent style perfectly suits this tactical setup and he has the best recent form to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Kalir or Casamorati can track the leader without getting involved in early pace
scenarios.body: They get the perfect trip behind the uncontested leader and can time their challenge perfectly as the hold-up horses struggle for racing room. The patient prominent style wins out over pure speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly in the final three furlongs and gaps appear
scenarios.body: Satoyama or Hippology can unleash their finishing kick from the back of the field where they've been saving ground. The O'Brien pair have the class to overcome the tactical disadvantage if the race opens up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Loch Gamhna stops quickly and the prominent horses also empty
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalise on the collapsed pace scenario. Traffic problems still favour those who avoided trouble rather than pure outsiders.

races.paceDynamic: Snapretend will take them along from the front with minimal pressure given he's the only confirmed early leader in this field. Contorsion, Denim And Diamonds and Jannah Star should settle prominently behind him, but none are aggressive pace-forcers. The moderate gallop will allow the strong hold-up brigade of Moody, Floresta, Nuit, Dippedinmoonlight, Tamam Desert and Bay Colony to get into contention turning for home. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks over the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Snapretend sets a steady tempo without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows closers like Moody and Floresta to unleash their superior class and finishing speed. Strong stayers with proven 1m6f form benefit most from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Success
scenarios.trigger: If Snapretend gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The leaders get first run on yielding ground while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. Snapretend's proven front-running ability at this trip becomes decisive advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is stronger than expected with multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: Several horses get caught wide or in traffic, creating chaos in the straight. Patient hold-up horses who avoid trouble benefit from others' misfortune.

scenarios.trigger: If Contorsion or Jannah Star challenge Snapretend early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo plays into the hands of deep closers with superior stamina reserves. The genuine 1m6f specialists come home strongest in testing conditions.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Up Front
scenarios.trigger: If Faiyum can control the pace and kick clear in the straight
scenarios.body: His superior rating and recent Listed form prove decisive despite carrying top weight. Subsonic may help by taking him along early before dropping away, setting up Faiyum's decisive move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is unsustainably fast and the front-runners collapse
scenarios.body: Lemsairbat and Sindria benefit from a truly-run race where their stamina and closing kick can be effective. The soft going plays to their patient tactics as the leaders tire dramatically.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Subsonic Springs Surprise

scenarios.body: The longest absence runner produces a fresh performance at rewarding odds. His front-running style pays dividends if the more fancied pace-setters engage in a speed duel.

races.paceDynamic: Ramair looks the sole confirmed front-runner with Honey Dale and He's Holding Court the only other prominent racers in this 14-runner field. This creates a dream scenario for the pace-setter as Ramair can dictate fractions without serious early pressure, likely getting soft sectionals through the middle stages. The majority of this field are hold-up horses who will need luck in running and gaps to appear in the straight. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Ramair gets an easy lead and Julian Pietropaolo judges the fractions correctly
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls the tempo and has enough left to resist late challenges, while the hold-up brigade get caught in traffic behind a wall of horses. This suits the rare front-runner who can exploit the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and clear gaps open up for the hold-up brigade in the straight
scenarios.body: A faster-than-expected early pace sets up a closer or one of the better hold-up horses finds racing room at the crucial moment. The front-runners pay for their earlier efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ramair goes too slow early and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with the entire field still in contention at the furlong pole, creating chaos and allowing an outsider to slip through. Pure lottery scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Young Churchill is the only confirmed front runner in this 16-runner field, giving him an uncontested lead from the off. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics (Kitty Bear, Majestic King, Thegooseiscooked, Can I Kiss You, Staywitherjohnny), Young Churchill can dictate comfortable fractions without pressure. The prominent horses Carvalhal, Verhoyen and Shahada Ace may track him but lack the pace to apply serious early pressure. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to Young Churchill's sustainable gallop, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses in the straight with limited room to manoeuvre.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Young Churchill maintains his lead unchallenged through comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: Young Churchill gets first run on the field and the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in a bunched finish. His early positioning advantage proves decisive when the kick comes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Carvalhal or Verhoyen can stalk Young Churchill closely and outkick him
scenarios.body: The prominent trackers get the perfect tow behind Young Churchill's honest gallop then have more left in the tank for the finish. They benefit from the leader doing the donkey work while staying out of traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and gaps open for late closers
scenarios.body: Kitty Bear, Thegooseiscooked or Majestic King find racing room in a slowly-run affair where stamina trumps position. Their superior class tells when the race becomes a sprint.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Young Churchill goes too slow and the field bunches dangerously
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops with interference as 15 horses try to challenge one leader simultaneously. The winner emerges from luck rather than merit in a photo finish.

watchPoints.text: Young Churchill's jumping - any sluggish start could see prominent horses challenge his uncontested lead
Traffic problems developing at the 2f pole as 15 hold-up horses try to find racing room simultaneously
Verhoyen and Shahada Ace for signs of their usual fading finish pattern kicking in
Kitty Bear and Thegooseiscooked need to be handy turning in or they'll have too much to do
Carvalhal's fitness after 190-day layoff - watch for any signs of rustiness in the closing stages
